artworks.title: James II, King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man identified as James II, King of Scots. He is shown facing slightly to the right, with his facial features, long wavy hair, soft cap, regal attire, and baton prominently displayed. The background is ornate, with inscriptions in Latin below the portrait.

artworks.title: James III, King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up, facing forward with delicate facial features including a long nose, full lips, and light, shoulder-length wavy hair. He wears a complex headpiece, a regal tunic with a high collar and an open front revealing a decorated garment underneath. He also wears a chain of office or necklace, and holds a scroll in his hand. The background features an ornate oval frame with decorative floral motifs and a Latin inscription below identifying the man as "Iacobus III, Rex, Scotorvm."

artworks.title: James IV, King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man with long hair and a youthful appearance. He is seated and facing the viewer, wearing a robe and a vest-like garment with fur trim. He has a cap with a badge and holds a thistle in his right hand. The portrait is surrounded by ornate decoration with botanical designs and Latin inscriptions below it, including the name "IACOBVS. IIII. REX. SCOTORVM."

artworks.title: James V, King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image displays a bust-length portrait of a man known as Iacobus V in an intricate drawing. He is seated, slightly turned to his left, with a serious expression. His features include a prominent nose, a small beard and moustache, and defined cheekbones. He has neatly styled hair with a portion swept to the side, adorned by a decorative hat. The man wears a detailed doublet under a cloak decorated with pearls, topped with a hat resembling a jeweled beret. He also wears a chain around his neck with an emblem. The composition is surrounded by ornate designs and a rectangular border with geometric patterns. Below the portrait, there is Latin text inscribed for additional context.

artworks.title: Mary, Queen of Scots
artworks.description: The image is a portrait depicting a woman in historical noble attire. She is positioned facing forward, with her head slightly tilted to the right. The woman has a serene expression, soft eyes, and arched eyebrows. Her hair is styled elegantly around her face, with curls visible under a hat or headpiece. She is adorned in clothing typical of historical nobility, including a lace ruff around her neck, intricate patterns, puffy sleeves, and holding a cross pendant. The background has a halo-effect framing her head and decorative motifs in the corners. The caption reads "MARIA REG: SCOTORVM," referencing Mary, Queen of Scots.

artworks.title: James VI, King of Scotland
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man seated and facing forward. He wears a tall, ornate hat with a cross-like decoration, a prominent mustache, a neatly trimmed goatee, and elaborate clothing with a fur-lined robe, buttons, and a ruffled collar. His hands are adorned with rings. The background is a textured oval frame with decorative leaf motifs at the corners. Text in Latin at the bottom identifies him as "IACOBVS. VI REX SCOTORVM."

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark, Queen of James VI of Scotland
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of Anna Regina Scotorum, depicted in an ornate oval frame. She is shown from the upper body up, looking directly at the viewer. Her facial features are detailed, with a composed expression and distinctive cheekbones. She has styled high hair adorned with a jeweled piece resembling a crown or headpiece. She wears a richly decorated dress with a high lace ruff at the neck, featuring intricate patterns. A strand of jewels or beads adorns her neck. The background of the engraving is decorated with floral and scroll motifs in a detailed border.

artworks.title: James I of England and James VI of Scotland
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing in a formal pose. The individual is positioned with one hand resting on their hip and the other hand holding a slender, ornate staff. Their facial features are detailed, with a pointed beard and mustache, and they are wearing a tall, cylindrical hat with a brim. The person's hair, which appears to be short and neatly styled, is visible beneath the hat. They are dressed in elaborate, historic clothing, featuring a richly patterned and layered outfit with a prominent ruffled collar and voluminous sleeves. A long, fur-trimmed cape drapes over their shoulders. No visible jewelry is shown, but their attire is heavily adorned with intricate patterns. In the background, there is a large coat of arms displayed on the right side, and a crown resting on a draped table. On the left side, an archway opens to a seascape with a ship on the water, and above the archway, there is a Latin inscription "IACOBUS VI. REX SCOTORUM." The floor beneath is checkered.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length view of a person standing upright and positioned forward with a slight turn to the left. The individual has distinct facial features with high cheekbones and a formal hairstyle. They wear an ornate gown with intricate patterns, a large ruffled collar, and a richly decorated robe. The person holds a staff with an embellished end and there is a crown on a surface nearby, along with two smaller figures wearing formal attire and crowns. The background displays heraldic symbols and inscriptions reading "ANNA REGINA SCOTORVM," alongside a closed arched door. The setting indicates an interior space, possibly a court or royal chamber.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a woman standing upright, facing forward with her left hand on her waist. In her right hand, she holds a scepter-like object with a decoration resembling a griffin. She has delicate features, a ruff around her face, elaborate hair adorned with an orb-like decoration, and is adorned in an ornate gown with a wide collar and flowing cape. The gown has intricate details and textures. Next to her is a heraldic banner held by a unicorn with a coat of arms. Below is a smaller image of two figures in similar attire with a crown above them. The background includes an archway, a tapestry or curtain, and the inscription "ANNA REGINA SCOTORVM" above, indicating she is a queen. The setting evokes a courtly or regal atmosphere.

artworks.title: James I and Prince Henry Frederick
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures. The person on the right is standing with one hand on their hip and the other resting on a table that is covered with a patterned cloth. They are wearing a suit of armor, complete with a pleated skirt and a feathered hat. Their facial features include a mustache and a pointed beard, and they have short hair that is mostly covered by the hat. The person on the left stands with their arms by their sides, dressed in a similar style but less ornate suit with a short skirt and hose. Their facial features are more youthful, with a smooth, rounded face and short hair. In the background, there is a heavy curtain draping down and a coat of arms displayed on the wall. On the table next to the standing figure is a decorated helmet adorned with a large plume of feathers, and there are small crown symbols arranged on the tablecloth. The floor is tiled with a geometric pattern. Above the figures are labeled boxes with names.

artworks.title: Charles I, at 13 Years of Age
artworks.description: This image features an engraved portrait of a young individual, likely a prince. The portrait focuses on the upper body, with the individual facing forward and slightly turned to the left. The facial features display a smooth complexion, round cheeks, and a calm expression. The individual has short, closely-cropped hair and wears elaborate, formal attire with a high collar and detailed embroidery. The frame around the portrait is ornate, with an architectural design including columns and a checkered floor pattern. An inscription within the frame reads: "THE HIGHE AND MIGHTY CHARLES PRINCE OF GREAT BRITANNY &c Aetatis suae 13."

artworks.title: James I and Anne of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures. The man on the left has one hand on his hip, holding a wide-brimmed hat with a plume. He wears puffed shorts and a doublet with decorative patterns, and has a beard and a mustache. The woman on the right stands upright, holding a fan. She wears a large, ruffled collar, a gown with intricate designs, and her hair is styled high. Both figures wear opulent attire indicating nobility. The man has a sheathed sword and a helmet near his feet. The background features a landscape with rugged terrains and distant hills.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man standing slightly turned to his right with his face looking forward. He has styled facial hair, including a mustache and a pointed beard. The man wears a tall hat with decorations, a richly decorated garment with detailed patterns, and a sash across his chest. He holds a scepter or rod in his right hand, and there is a large plumed helmet beside him. The background features mountains or rocky formations.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, seated in a forward-facing position. She has a long, angular face with high cheekbones and fine, arched eyebrows. Her hair is styled with curls framing her face and a decorative headdress. She wears an ornate dress with a wide, lace-embellished collar and intricate patterns on the sleeves and front. She holds a fan in her right hand and a piece of fabric in her left, with a string of pearls around her neck. The background features a scenic landscape with rolling hills, trees, and distant buildings.

artworks.title: James I and Anne of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman in an ornate setting. The man stands near the seated woman. The man wears distinctive clothing, a large hat with a feather, and holds a scepter. The woman wears an elegant dress, and both figures are surrounded by a detailed backdrop with textured elements and a coat of arms displayed prominently. Latin text is inscribed at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: James I
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with one hand on the hilt of a sword and the other on his hip. He has a mustache, beard, and wears a hat with a feather, a doublet with epaulets and a ruffled collar, a fur-trimmed cape, and a medallion hanging from his neck. He has a sheathed sword on his belt. There are drapery curtains in the background and a table with an open book in the lower left corner. A poem is inscribed at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Anne of Denmark
artworks.description: The image shows a woman positioned slightly to the right, with her left arm bent at the elbow and resting on a draped surface. Her right hand holds what appears to be a book or paper. Her facial features are detailed, with high cheekbones, a slender nose, and a serene expression. Her hair is styled elaborately with a high bouffant style, incorporating a headpiece adorned with jewels. She wears an intricate dress adorned with a detailed pattern, puffed shoulders, and a large ruffled collar. Around her neck, she has a double-stranded pearl necklace and a pendant with a bow design. Her left wrist is adorned with a bracelet, and from her right elbow crook, she holds a large feather fan. The background features heavy drapery cascading down, framing the subject elegantly.

artworks.title: Charles I with the Infanta of Spain
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures standing closely together. The central figure is dressed in robes and sandals with a halo. To the left is a man wearing a crown, a high-collared ruff, and ornate clothing. To the right is a woman wearing a crown, a ruff, and a lavish gown. The background shows an outdoor landscape with trees, hills, and clouds. Latin inscriptions are above and below the figures.

artworks.title: Queen Mary I of England
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up in a formal portrait position. The person faces forward, holding a scepter in their right hand. Their facial features include a serious expression with downturned eyes and moderately full lips, framed by neatly arranged hair. They wear an elaborate garment with intricate detailing, such as pearls or small jewels, along the neckline and bodice. A crown adorns their head. The background is plain and unadorned. At the bottom of the image, there is text in a script style.

artworks.title: Queen Elizabeth
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a woman believed to be Elizabeth, Queen of England. She has a composed facial expression with high cheekbones, almond-shaped eyes, and curly hair styled elegantly with a crown adorned with pearls and a star motif. She wears rich attire with a ruff around her neck and an ornate gown with floral designs. She is holding a scepter in her right hand and an orb in her left hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Henry VIII, Edward VI, Mary I and Elizabeth
artworks.description: In the image, there are full-body portraits of four historical figures standing side by side. The first figure is an armored male wearing a crown, holding a sword and shield with royal emblems. The second figure is an armored male with a crown, holding a baton and a shield with similar emblems. The third figure is a female in a luxurious gown with a fur-trimmed cape and crown, holding a shield. The fourth figure is a female in grand attire with intricate patterns, wearing a crown and holding a scepter with a dignified posture. The background is plain, emphasizing the detailed representation of the figures' clothing and accessories.

artworks.title: Albert, Archduke of Austria
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an oval frame, facing slightly left with his head turned towards the viewer. He has a prominent nose, arched eyebrows, a trimmed beard, and mustache. His hair is swept back, and he wears a richly adorned garment typical of nobility. A large ruff encircles his neck and there are intricate details in the clothing and decoration. The portrait is of Prince Albert Archduke of Austria, Duke of Burgundy, and Prince of Belgium. The background features textured lines and the frame has decorative bands with inscriptions in Latin.

artworks.title: Gervase Babington, Bishop
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an elderly man from the waist up. He is positioned facing forward with his head slightly turned to the left. The man has a long, full beard and mustache, with a bald head and a short fringe of hair. He wears a long robe with a brocade texture over a dark vest and shirt, adorned with a large, pleated ruff around the neck. His attire is voluminous and appears to be of rich fabric, gathered at the wrists. The man holds a small, closed book in his left hand, with ornate detailing on the cover. In the background, a banner with the Latin phrase "Virtus Dei in Infirmitate" is visible, and above the portrait, there is a script that denotes his name and titles. The entire background consists of a plain, neutral tone, with additional text inscriptions along the bottom border of the image. The artwork is contained within a rectangular frame.
